# Relevance Assessment

This folder covers the evaluation of clinical quality indicators and their applicability to specific patient populations within the acute surgery database corpus. The available evidence is currently limited to a single institutional assessment by Regionshospital Nordjylland, which determined that Indikator 3 is most relevant for a distinct demographic referred to as "4X patients." It provides a focused look at how hospitals judge the practical utility and target audience of specific clinical metrics.

## Pages

- [[relevance-assessment|Relevance Assessment]] — Evaluates the applicability of clinical quality indicators to specific patient groups, specifically noting Regionshospital Nordjylland's assessment of Indikator 3 for "4X patients."
